_comment: Maps Givex outlet_id and/or Givex store_name to the exact Location_Name used in Store_Data. byOutletId is checked first, then byStoreName as a fallback. excludeOutletIds lists outlet_ids that are real Givex outlets but NOT real Mezza customer locations (test/internal/unclear) -- these are dropped from the output entirely and counted separately, so their sales never silently land in a bucket. Real outlet_ids below came from a production Get Store List call on 2026-08-17.

excludeOutletIds.65659: Beta Lanner -- Givex certification/test store, not a real Mezza location
excludeOutletIds.400005198: Mezza Lebanese Kitchen - Test Lab -- internal test outlet, not a real customer-facing location
excludeOutletIds.400005054: Mezza - Head Office -- not a store
excludeOutletIds.201541: Mezza Lebanese Kitchen - SmoothPay Commerce Store -- unclear purpose, not a known Store_Data Location_Name; confirm with Peter before ever including
excludeOutletIds.195423: Mezza CWS store -- unclear purpose, not a known Store_Data Location_Name; confirm with Peter before ever including
